SELECT 'VIEW' AS history_type, TO_CHAR(info.INSERT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS occurred_at, info.USER_ID AS actor_user_id, info.USER_NM AS actor_user_nm, CASE WHEN info.DISTRIBUTION_TYPE = 'FunctionCode' THEN 'Documents' WHEN info.DISTRIBUTION_TYPE = 'CCB' THEN '기술자료관리' ELSE info.DISTRIBUTION_TYPE END AS distribution_type, info.DRAWING_NO AS drawing_no, info.OBJECT_ID AS object_id, info.ORG_FILE_NM AS org_file_nm, info.REVISION AS revision, 'SUCCESS' AS status_cd FROM DOCS_HISTORY info WHERE info.LOG_TYPE = 'VIEWING'
AND info.DISTRIBUTION_TYPE = 'CCB'
AND info.DISTRIBUTION_TYPE = 'FunctionCode'
AND info.DISTRIBUTION_TYPE = #{distributionType}
AND (COALESCE(info.USER_ID, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(info.USER_NM, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(info.DRAWING_NO, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(info.OBJECT_ID, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(info.ORG_FILE_NM, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY info.INSERT_DATE DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT 'PRINT' AS history_type, TO_CHAR(job.REQUESTED_AT AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS occurred_at, TO_CHAR(job.COMPLETED_AT AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS completed_at, job.ACTOR_USER_CD AS actor_user_cd, job.ACTOR_USER_ID AS actor_user_id, job.ACTOR_USER_NM AS actor_user_nm, job.PRINT_JOB_ID AS print_job_id, item.ITEM_SEQ AS item_seq, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY job.PRINT_JOB_ID) AS item_count, COALESCE(item.OBJECT_TYPE, job.OBJECT_TYPE) AS object_type, COALESCE(item.OBJECT_ID, job.OBJECT_ID) AS object_id, COALESCE(item.FILE_NO, job.FILE_NO) AS file_no, COALESCE(item.REQUEST_NO, job.REQUEST_NO) AS request_no, item.REQUEST_TYPE AS request_type, job.STATUS_CD AS status_cd, job.PAGE_COUNT AS page_count, job.COPY_COUNT AS copy_count, job.PRINTER_NM AS printer_nm, job.DEVICE_ID AS device_id, job.CLIENT_IP AS client_ip, job.ERROR_MESSAGE AS error_message FROM DOCS_PRINT_JOB job LEFT JOIN DOCS_PRINT_JOB_ITEM item ON item.PRINT_JOB_ID = job.PRINT_JOB_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND job.STATUS_CD = #{statusCd}
AND (COALESCE(job.ACTOR_USER_ID, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(job.ACTOR_USER_NM, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(job.PRINT_JOB_ID, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(item.OBJECT_ID, job.OBJECT_ID, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(item.FILE_NO, job.FILE_NO, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(item.REQUEST_NO, job.REQUEST_NO, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(job.PRINTER_NM, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY job.REQUESTED_AT DESC, item.ITEM_SEQ LIMIT 1000
